Class PendingCraftingJobResultIndexObserver<T,M>

java.lang.Object
org.cyclops.integratedcrafting.core.PendingCraftingJobResultIndexObserver<T,M>
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.cyclops.integrateddynamics.core.network.IIngredientChannelInsertPreConsumer<T>
public class PendingCraftingJobResultIndexObserver<T,M> extends Object implements org.cyclops.integrateddynamics.core.network.IIngredientChannelInsertPreConsumer<T>
An ingredient index observer that tracks crafting job outputs for a certain ingredient component type. It will observe changes and (partially) resolve awaiting crafting job outputs when applicable.

    • addIngredient

      public org.cyclops.commoncapabilities.api.ingredient.IngredientInstanceWrapper<T,M> addIngredient(org.cyclops.commoncapabilities.api.ingredient.IngredientInstanceWrapper<T,M> instanceWrapper, int channel, boolean simulate)
      This adds the given instance to the waiting crafting jobs directly, without having to go through the network storage and its observers. Like the method above, this will first attempt to complete running jobs that are awaiting results. Then, it will try to give the instance to the dependent jobs based on their missing ingredients.
      Parameters:
      instanceWrapper - The instance to add.
      channel - The channel.
      simulate - Simulate mode.
      Returns:
      The remaining instance that could not be given to any jobs that had missing ingredients.
